pulled 10:33 NZDT (rsync), 2016 timings. L=8192 placements (C): warm L2 6/6 significant, range 29-41% at chunks 32-256 (8.2% at 512, 2.6% at 1024), per-placement ranking stable across rounds (median Spearman 0.96); cold L2 range 0.5-2.3%. Same-buffer inputs (A) at L=8192: <=0.6% warm, <=0.3% cold. L=2048 (working set a quarter of L2): no stable placement ranking (Spearman 0.12), 0/6 significant warm. Conclusion: the PRO 6000 fixed-chunk effects are L2 residency of the ~128 MiB working set, set by buffer placement, not values
